newsitem.title: JAPAN: Paper says Yamaichi reimbursed Hanwa for losses.
newsitem.headline: Paper says Yamaichi reimbursed Hanwa for losses.

text.p: A newspaper said on Monday that leading Japanese brokerage Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd reimbursed Hanwa Co Ltd for investment losses in 1992 by exercising a right to buy Hanwa stock for more than the market price.
A Yamaichi spokesman said the company could not immediately comment on the report in the Sankei Shimbun, but would try to make checks. Hanwa officials were not immediately available for comment.
The newspaper said Yamaichi transferred about 18.9 billion yen to steel product maker Hanwa between April and September 1992 through transactions involving bonds with equity-purchase warrants.
The transaction was made to cover appraisal losses at the Hanwa group on securities investments managed by Yamaichi, the paper said.
